title.zh: 规定在东萨马省Llorente市镇设立急诊医院，名称为Llorente急诊医院，并为此拨款的法案
title.en: An Act Providing for the Establishment of An Emergency Hospital in the Municipality of Llorente, Province of Eastern Samar, to Be Known as the Llorente Emergency Hospital and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Providing for the Establishment of An Emergency Hospital in the Municipality of Llorente, Province of Eastern Samar, to Be Known as the Llorente Emergency Hospital and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập Bệnh viện Cấp cứu tại Thị trấn Llorente, Tỉnh Eastern Samar với tên gọi Bệnh viện Cấp cứu Llorente, và phân bổ kinh phí cho mục đích này
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งโรงพยาบาลฉุกเฉินในเทศบาล Llorente จังหวัด Eastern Samar ในชื่อโรงพยาบาลฉุกเฉิน Llorente และจัดสรรเงินทุนสำหรับการนี้

text.en: There is hereby established an emergency hospital in the Municipality of Llorente, Province of Eastern Samar, to be known as the Llorente Emergency Hospital, under the direct supervision of the Secretary of the Department of Health. Its bed capacity shall not be less than twenty-five nor more than fifty.

The sum of one hundred fifty thousand pesos is hereby appropriated, out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated, for the establishment, operation and maintenance of said hospital during the fiscal year nineteen hundred seventy. Thereafter, such sums as may be needed for its operation and maintenance shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Enacted without Executive approval, June 19, 1971.
